Docs/Replay/Guide

Replay

Replay scene adapters

1 min readOdin × GodotPage source ↓

Import scenegd "godot:replay/godot/scene" for Godot presentation and authored content. Gameplay values come from Replay; these owners keep Godot nodes, Resources, callbacks and visual lifetimes outside the replayable World.

Choose the helper for the scene's lifetime:

  • Script_Binding borrows an existing authored scene. Use script_bind, script_present and script_release; the scene keeps its Godot lifetime.
  • View_Pool2 owns a bounded set of entity scene instances. Use view_pool_load, view_pool_present and view_pool_destroy with explicit generation handles and view scopes.
  • Script_Archetypes combines typed scene scripts with retained scenes and appearance Resources. Its descriptor has one optional report-returning validate callback.
  • Bake_Context, Resource_Batch and Archetype_Assets validate authored Resources and scenes, then publish copied gameplay values or retained local presentation assets.
  • Audio_Pool, effect routes and body adapters provide bounded presentation and explicit physics ownership. session_body* and session_tick_phase consume the public Session lifecycle.

Keep live owners and borrowed callback configuration at stable addresses. Destroy them before their parent nodes or compiled script module disappear. The framework owns pooled root transforms; scene-local scripts own their child animation. A detached display value can be copied; a live pool or binding cannot.

Use replaygd "godot:replay/godot" for Session/Room/Party. Scene adapters import that lifecycle package when they need it, keeping presentation optional for a game that only uses networking. See typed adapters, view pools, body contracts and the checked recipes.
